subject.title: Add package changelog previews for plugin publishing

question: Should platform moderators and admins be allowed to generate a changelog preview that reads historical README content for packages outside their ownership scope?
rationale: The patch deliberately grants this privileged path and tests it, but whether staff moderation authority also permits disclosure of prior package content to the preview/model path is a repository policy choice rather than a mechanical defect.

options.title: Approve staff preview authority
options.body: Confirm that moderator and admin moderation authority includes reading historical package README content for preview generation, then merge with the current role coverage.

options.title: Limit previews to publisher authority
options.body: Remove moderator/admin bypasses so only the direct owner and authorized publisher members can generate previews for an existing package.

recommendation.title: Approve staff preview authority
recommendation.body: Confirm that moderator and admin moderation authority includes reading historical package README content for preview generation, then merge with the current role coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership and visibility work on the active package-publish path makes this the closest established owner for the access-policy decision.
